title: Sugreeva's second fight and Vali's falling down
introduction: Vali dismissing Tara's words, who is dissuading him to confront Rama, starts out to fight out Sugreeva. A ghastly fight ensues in which Vali depletes Sugreeva's strength by the boon and Indra's chest-plate, and thus Sugreeva seeks Rama's help. Rama shoots his arrow which hits Vali on chest, but does not render him dead immediately. Thus that great mighty and unassailable Vali is brought down to ground.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये किष्किन्ध काण्डे षोडशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 16th chapter in Kishkindha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
ताम् एवम् ब्रुवतीम् ताराम् ताराधिप निभ आननाम् |
वाली निर्भर्त्सयामास वचनम् च इदम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tām evam bruvatīm tārām tārādhipa nibha ānanām |
vālī nirbhartsayāmāsa vacanam ca idam abravīt
verses.translation: While Tara with a face that shines like the lord of stars is speaking thus, Vali dauntingly spoke to her with these words.

glosses.itrans: evam bruvatiim taaraa adhipa nibha aananaam
glosses.iast: evam bruvatīm tārā adhipa nibha ānanām
glosses.devanagari: एवं ब्रुवतीं तारा अधिप निभ आननां
glosses.meaning: stars', lord's [moon,] in shine, faced one

verses.devanagari:
गर्जतो अस्य च सुसंरब्धम् भ्रातुः शत्रोर् विशेषतः |
मर्षयिष्यामि केन कारणेन वरानने
verses.iast:
garjato asya ca susaṃrabdham bhrātuḥ śatror viśeṣataḥ |
ma.rṣayiṣyāmi kena kāraṇena varānane
verses.translation: "He is an younger brother and an adversary in particular, oh, pretty-faced Tara, can I by any reason tolerate him when he kept raving on frenetically, tell me.

glosses.meaning: by which [by any,] even, by reason

verses.devanagari:
अधर्षितानाम् शूराणाम् समरेषु अनिवर्तिनाम् |
धर्षणाम् अर्षणम् भीरु मरणात् अतिरिच्यते
verses.iast:
adharṣitānām śūrāṇām samareṣu anivartinām |
dharṣaṇām arṣaṇam bhīru maraṇāt atiricyate
verses.translation: "To those valiant ones who neither give ground nor get assailed in wars, oh, shyly, endurance of a overweening war-whoop is more than death.

glosses.meaning: un, assailed ones [not get assailed by their incompetence]

verses.devanagari:
सोढुम् न च समर्थो अहम् युद्ध कामस्य संयुगे |
सुग्रीवस्य च संरंभम् हीन ग्रीवस्य गर्जतम्
verses.iast:
soḍhum na ca samartho aham yuddha kāmasya saṃyuge |
sugrīvasya ca saṃrambham hīna grīvasya garjatam
verses.translation: "I am incapable of withstanding that dumbly Sugreeva's bawling commotion desiring a brawling duel.

glosses.meaning: brawl, desiring, hiina griivasya = feeble, voiced [dumbly]
to withstand, not, also, I am capable.

verses.devanagari:
न च कार्यो विषादः ते राघवम् प्रति मत् कृते |
धर्मज्ञः च कृतज्ञः च कथम् पापम् करिष्यति
verses.iast:
na ca kāryo viṣādaḥ te rāghavam prati mat kṛte |
dharmajñaḥ ca kṛtajñaḥ ca katham pāpam kariṣyati
verses.translation: "Also, you need not bother about Raghava's doing some harm to me, as I wonder how a diligent man and knower of virtue can commit sin.

glosses.meaning: in my, respect - some harm to me
to you, botheration, not, also, to be done - you need not bother
sin, how, can do - I wonder.

verses.devanagari:
निवर्तस्व सह स्त्रीभिः कथम् भूयो अनुगच्छसि |
सौहृदम् दर्शितम् तावत् मयि भक्तिः त्वया कृता
verses.iast:
nivartasva saha strībhiḥ katham bhūyo anugacchasi |
sauhṛdam darśitam tāvat mayi bhak{}tiḥ tvayā kṛtā
verses.translation: "How do you follow me again, you return with all these females, truly you have expressed your friendliness owing to your devotion to me.

glosses.meaning: by you, friendliness, is shown - expressed, truly

verses.devanagari:
प्रति योत्स्यामि अहम् गत्वा सुग्रीवम् जहि संभ्रमम् |
दर्पम् च अस्य विनेष्यामि न च प्राणैर् वियोक्ष्यते
verses.iast:
prati yotsyāmi aham gatvā sugrīvam jahi sambhramam |
darpam ca asya vineṣyāmi na ca prāṇair viyokṣyate
verses.translation: "You may do away with your perplexity as I will retaliate Sugreeva on my going there only to drive him and his arrogance out, but without letting his lives loose.

glosses.meaning: I, on going, with Sugreeva, counter, attack - retaliate
his, arrogance, also, I will drive out
by lives, not, [he will] be released - his lives will not be released.

verses.devanagari:
अहम् हि अजि स्थितस्य अस्य करिष्यामि यत् ईप्सितम् |
वृक्षैः मुष्टि प्रहारैः च पीडितः प्रति यास्यति
verses.iast:
aham hi aji sthitasya asya kariṣyāmi yat īpsitam |
vṛkśaiḥ muṣṭi prahāraiḥ ca pīḍitaḥ prati yāsyati
verses.translation: "As he is firmed up for a combat, I will indeed have to effectuate what his desire is, by caning with trees and fistfights, by which roughed up he returns.

glosses.meaning: [ by caning] with trees, fist, fights, also

verses.devanagari:
न मे गर्वितम् आयस्तम् सहिष्यति दुरात्मवान् |
कृतम् तारे सहायत्वम् दर्शितम् सौहृदम् मयि
verses.iast:
na me garvitam āyastam sahiṣyati durātmavān |
kṛtam tāre sahāyatvam darśitam sauhṛdam mayi
verses.translation: "My nerve and pace of combat will be insufferable to that malign minded Sugreeva, oh, Tara, you have offered your helping suggestion and you have shown all your friendliness to me, it is enough.

glosses.meaning: in me, friendliness, shown [by you, it is enough.]

verses.devanagari:
शापिता असि मम प्राणैः निवर्तस्व जनेन च |
अलम् जित्वा निवर्तिष्ये तम् अहम् भ्रातरम् रणे
verses.iast:
śāpitā asi mama prāṇaiḥ nivartasva janena ca |
alam jitvā nivartiṣye tam aham bhrātaram raṇe
verses.translation: "I adjured you on my lives, return with your followers, and I shall return to you on easily defeating and returning that 'brother of mine." Said Vali to Tara.

glosses.meaning: on my, lives, sworn, you are
in combat, easily, on defeating, I return [revert Sugreeva.]

verses.devanagari:
तम् तु तारा परिष्वज्य वालिनम् प्रिय वादिनी |
चकार रुदती मन्दम् दक्षिणा सा प्रदक्षिणम्
verses.iast:
tam tu tārā pariṣvajya vālinam priya vādinī |
cakāra rudatī mandam dakṣiṇā sā pradakṣiṇam
verses.translation: She that pleasant articulator and talented Tara then hugged and circumabulated Vali, suppressing her moaning, as an honour to the braver.

verses.devanagari:
ततः स्वस्त्ययनम् कृत्वा मंत्रवित् विजय एषिणी |
अंतःपुरम् सह स्त्रीभिः प्रविष्टा शोक मोहिता
verses.iast:
tataḥ svastyayanam kṛtvā maṃtravit vijaya eṣiṇī |
aṃtaḥpuram saha strībhiḥ praviṣṭā śoka mohitā
verses.translation: Then she who is a hymnodist that Tara has performed a hymnal bon voyage wishing triumph to Vali, and entered palace chambers along with other females, disoriented by her own sadness.
notes: The svatyayanais a Vedic formality performed by the mothers / wives of the combating gallants at the time of the departure of heros to battlefields, by placing red tilakaon forehead, ārati, with camphor burning, akśata, sprinkling grain on head, handing him his bow or sword, all with respective Vedic hymns. The weaponry of these heroes will be in the custody of their wives, for they have to worship the weaponry that brings victory to their husbands. Seetha also gives Rama his bow and sword in Aranya Kanda, on his departure to forests from Suteekshna's hermitage as at 3-8-18.

glosses.meaning: blessings, for journey [bon voyage,] on making

verses.devanagari:
प्रविष्टायाम् तु तारायाम् सह स्त्रीभिः स्वम् आलयम् |
नगर्या निर्ययौ क्रुद्धो महा सर्प इव श्वसन्
verses.iast:
praviṣṭāyām tu tārāyām saha strībhiḥ svam ālayam |
nagaryā niryayau kruddho mahā sarpa iva śvasan
verses.translation: On Tara entering her own palace chambers along with other females, Vali emerged out of the city hissing like an infuriated great snake.

verses.devanagari:
स निःश्वस्य महारोषो वाली परम वेगवान् |
सर्वतः चारयन् दृष्टिम् शत्रु दर्शन कांक्षया
verses.iast:
sa niḥśvasya mahāroṣo vālī parama vegavān |
sarvataḥ cārayan dṛṣṭim śatru darśana kāṃkṣayā
verses.translation: He that highly rancorous Vali suspired with high audacity and spread his sight everywhere intending to sight his enemy.

verses.devanagari:
स ददर्श ततः श्रीमान् सुग्रीवम् हेम पिङ्गलम् |
सुसंवीतम् अवष्टब्धम् दीप्यमानम् इव अनलम्
verses.iast:
sa dadarśa tataḥ śrīmān sugrīvam hema piñgalam |
susaṃvītam avaṣṭabdham dīpyamānam iva analam
verses.translation: Then that celebrated Vali saw Sugreeva who is in golden-ochre hue, whose girdle cloth is tightened for a fight, and who is with an air of self-confidence, blazing like fiery-fire.

verses.devanagari:
तम् स दृष्ट्वा महाबाहुः सुग्रीवम् पर्यवस्थितम् |
गाढम् परिदधे वासो वाली परम कोपिनः
verses.iast:
tam sa dṛṣṭvā mahābāhuḥ sugrīvam paryavasthitam |
gāḍham paridadhe vāso vālī parama kopinaḥ
verses.translation: That strong armed Vali who is highly provoked has also tightened his girdle cloth on seeing proximately available Sugreeva.

glosses.meaning: cloth, tightly, he wore [tightened his own girdle cloth.]

verses.devanagari:
स वाली गाढ संवीतो मुष्टिम् उद्यम्य वीर्यवान् |
सुग्रीवम् एव अभिमुखो ययौ योद्धुम् कृत क्षणः
verses.iast:
sa vālī gāḍha saṃvīto muṣṭim udyamya vīryavān |
sugrīvam eva abhimukho yayau yoddhum kṛta kṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: He that formidable Vali strongly tightening his girdle-cloth too, and proceeded towards Sugreeva in a well timed manner uplifting fists to fight him off.

verses.devanagari:
श्लिष्टम् मुष्टिम् समुद्यम्य संरब्धतरम् आगतः |
सुग्रीवो अपि समुद्दिश्य वालिनम् हेम मालिनम्
verses.iast:
śliṣṭam muṣṭim samudyamya saṃrabdhataram āgataḥ |
sugrīvo api samuddiśya vālinam hema mālinam
verses.translation: Even Sugreeva has come at that imprudent Vali with golden pendant, on tightening his fists, lifting them up at the ready, and aiming them well at Vali.

glosses.meaning: tightening, fist, lifting at the ready
one with golden, pendent, at Vali
hasty, highly [hastiest imprudent Vali] has come at.

verses.devanagari:
तम् वाली क्रोध ताम्राक्षः सुग्रीवम् रण कोविदम् |
आपतंतम् महा वेगम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tam vālī krodha tāmrākṣaḥ sugrīvam raṇa kovidam |
āpataṃtam mahā vegam idam vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: Vali spoke this word to that Sugreeva who is swooping down on him, whose eyes are reddened in fury, and who is an expert and expeditious in fighting.

glosses.meaning: one with great, speed - expeditious one

verses.devanagari:
एष मुष्टिर् महान् बद्धो गाढः सुनियत अंगुलिः |
मया वेग विमुक्तः ते प्राणान् आदाय यास्यति
verses.iast:
eṣa muṣṭir mahān baddho gāḍhaḥ suniyata aṃguliḥ |
mayā vega vimuk{}taḥ te prāṇān ādāya yāsyati
verses.translation: "Properly clenching fingers this great fist of mine is firmly clenched, and it will unclench only on taking your lives when I pitch this on you at full speed." So said Vali threateningly to Sugreeva.

glosses.meaning: by me, very, speedily, while released [pitched]

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्तः तु सुग्रीवः क्रुद्धो वालिनम् अब्रवीत् |
तव च एष हरन् प्राणान् मुष्टिः पततु मूर्धनि
verses.iast:
evam uk{}taḥ tu sugrīvaḥ kruddho vālinam abravīt |
tava ca eṣa haran prāṇān muṣṭiḥ patatu mūrdhani
verses.translation: Thus said, Sugreeva with high dudgeon said, "this fist of mine shall fall on your forehead plundering your lives."

verses.devanagari:
ताडितः तेन तम् क्रुद्धः समभिक्रम्य वेगतः |
अभवत् शोणित उद्गारी सापीड इव पर्वतः
verses.iast:
tāḍitaḥ tena tam kruddhaḥ samabhikramya vegataḥ |
abhavat śoṇita udgārī sāpīḍa iva parvataḥ
verses.translation: Coming near instantaneously Vali hit him, whereby Sugreeva is enraged and became like a mountain streaming blood in its torrents.

glosses.meaning: one who is hit [Sugreeva - spilled blood]

verses.devanagari:
सुग्रीवेण तु निःशंकम् सालम् उत्पाट्य तेजसा |
गात्रेषु अभिहतो वाली वज्रेण इव महा गिरिः
verses.iast:
sugrīveṇa tu niḥśaṃkam sālam utpāṭya tejasā |
gātreṣu abhihato vālī vajreṇa iva mahā giriḥ
verses.translation: But Sugreeva unhesitatingly uprooted a saala tree with his force and thrashed the limbs of Vali as with the thunderbolt thrashing a great mountain.

glosses.meaning: by thunderbolt, great mountain, as with

verses.devanagari:
स तु वृक्षेण निर्भग्नः साल ताडन विह्वलः |
गुरु भार भर आक्रान्ता नौः ससार्था इव सागरे
verses.iast:
sa tu vṛkśeṇa nirbhagnaḥ sāla tāḍana vihvalaḥ |
guru bhāra bhara ākrāntā nauḥ sasārthā iva sāgare
verses.translation: But Vali when thwacked with saala tree had staggered and looked like a tossing ship in an ocean filled with heavy weight of merchandise and brimming with merchants, but on the brink of wrecking.

glosses.meaning: with saala tree, by thwacking, one who is staggered
heavy, weight, filled with, brimming with

verses.devanagari:
तौ भीम बल विक्रान्तौ सुपर्ण सम वेगिनौ |
प्रयुद्धौ घोर वपुषौ चन्द्र सूर्यौ इव अंबरे
परस्परम् अमित्र घ्नौ च्छिद्र अन्वेषण तत्परौ |
verses.iast:
tau bhīma bala vikrāntau suparṇa sama veginau |
prayuddhau ghora vapuṣau candra sūryau iva ambare
parasparam amitra ghnau cchidra anveṣaṇa tatparau |
verses.translation: Those two, Vali and Sugreeva, with their sensational energy, triumphing zeal, frightful physiques, swiftness as good as the Divine Eagle Garuda, vigilance in exploring perilous body parts of one another, ravagement of their own enemies fought frighteningly, like the sun and moon in the sky, which is inconceivable.

glosses.meaning: Divine Eagle, Garuda, equalling, in swiftness
] in sky, Moon, sun, like [which is an inconceivable fight]

verses.devanagari:
ततो अवर्धत वाली तु बल वीर्य समन्वितः
सूर्य पुत्रो महावीर्यः सुग्रीवः परिहीयत |
verses.iast:
tato avardhata vālī tu bala vīrya samanvitaḥ
sūrya putro mahāvīryaḥ sugrīvaḥ parihīyata |
verses.translation: But Vali being the possessor of might and vigour progressed and though greatly mighty is son of sun, Sugreeva, regressed.

verses.devanagari:
वालिना भग्न दर्पः तु सुग्रीवो मन्द विक्रमः
वालिनम् प्रति सामर्षो दर्शयामास राघवम् |
verses.iast:
vālinā bhagna darpaḥ tu sugrīvo manda vikramaḥ
vālinam prati sāmarṣo darśayāmāsa rāghavam |
verses.translation: Sugreeva became retardant in aggression when Vali routed his pride and then he exasperatedly started searching for Raghava to counteract Vali.

verses.devanagari:
वृक्षैः स शाखैः शिखरैः वज्र कोटि निभैः नखैः
मुष्टिभिः जानुभिः पद्भिः बाहुभिः च पुनः पुनः |
तयोः युद्द्धम् अभूत् घोरम् वृत्र वासवोः इव
verses.iast:
vṛkśaiḥ sa śākhaiḥ śikharaiḥ vajra koṭi nibhaiḥ nakhaiḥ
muṣṭibhiḥ jānubhiḥ padbhiḥ bāhubhiḥ ca punaḥ punaḥ |
tayoḥ yudddham abhūt ghoram vṛtra vāsavoḥ iva
verses.translation: Among those two there happened a deadly fight time and again using trees with branches, peaks of mountains, their own nails that are similar to the razor-sharp edges of thunderbolts, and with fists, knees, feet, and arms, like the fight that once chanced between demon Vritra and Indra.

glosses.meaning: thunderbolts, edges, similar [in sharpness,] with [edged] nails
with fists, with knees, with feet
among demon Vritra, Indra, like [as has happened]

verses.devanagari:
तौ शोणितात्कौ युध्येताम् वानारौ वन् चारिणौ |
मेघौ इव महा शब्दैः तर्जमानौ परस्परम्
verses.iast:
tau śoṇitāt{}kau yudhyetām vānārau van cāriṇau |
meghau iva mahā śabdaiḥ tarjamānau parasparam
verses.translation: Those forest moving vanara-s that are soaked in blood have gone on clashing, threatening each other, like two clouds clashing uproariously.

verses.devanagari:
हीयमानम् अथ अपश्यत् सुग्रीवम् वानरेश्वरम् |
प्रेक्षमाणम् दिशः च एव राघवः स मुहुर् मुहुर्
verses.iast:
hīyamānam atha apaśyat sugrīvam vānareśvaram |
prekśamāṇam diśaḥ ca eva rāghavaḥ sa muhur muhur
verses.translation: Raghava has then seen the lord of monkeys Sugreeva who is repeatedly eyeing all sides for help and who is even deteriorating in his enterprise.

verses.devanagari:
ततो रामो महातेजा आर्तम् दृष्ट्वा हरीश्वरम् |
स शरम् वीक्षते वीरो वालिनो वध कांक्षया
verses.iast:
tato rāmo mahātejā ārtam dṛṣṭvā harīśvaram |
sa śaram vīkśate vīro vālino vadha kāṃkśayā
verses.translation: On seeing the lord of monkeys Sugreeva in a forlornness, then the refulgent and fearless Rama scanned for an arrow aiming to eliminate Vali.

glosses.meaning: great, refulgent one, fearless one, he that Rama

verses.devanagari:
ततो धनुषि संधाय शरम् आशी विष उपमम् |
पूरयामास तत् चापम् काल चक्रम् इव अन्तकः
verses.iast:
tato dhanuṣi sandhāya śaram āśī viṣa upamam |
pūrayāmāsa tat cāpam kāla cakram iva antakaḥ
verses.translation: Then on tautening a venomous serpent like arrow in the bow, Rama started to draw out bowstring, whereby that bow attained a similitude with the Time-disc of the Terminator.

glosses.meaning: which has fang's, venom, in simile - venomous serpent like
started to draw out [the string,] that, bow.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य ज्यातल घोषेण त्रस्ताः पत्ररथेश्वराः |
प्रदुद्रुवुर् मृगाः च एव युगांत इव मोहिताः
verses.iast:
tasya jyātala ghoṣeṇa trastāḥ patraratheśvarāḥ |
pradudruvur mṛgāḥ ca eva yugāṃta iva mohitāḥ
verses.translation: At the blast of bowstring the lordly birds and animals are panicked, like those that will be startled by the approach of ear ending, and they all fled.

glosses.meaning: by wings, charioting - birds, lordly ones [very big birds, leave alone small birds]
at era, end, those that are startled, like

verses.devanagari:
मुक्तस्तु वज्र निर्घोषः प्रदीप्त अशनि संनिभः |
राघवेण महा बाणो वालि वक्षसि पातितः
verses.iast:
muk{}tastu vajra nirghoṣaḥ pradīpta aśani saṃnibhaḥ |
rāghaveṇa mahā bāṇo vāli vakṣasi pātitaḥ
verses.translation: The arrow released by Raghava that has the boom of thunderbolt's thunderclap and the flashes of a lightning fell on the chest of Vali.

glosses.meaning: thunderbolt's, with sound of - boom of thunderclap

verses.devanagari:
ततः तेन महातेजा वीर्य युक्तः कपीश्वरः |
वेगेन अभिहतो वाली निपपात मही तले
verses.iast:
tataḥ tena mahātejā vīrya yuk{}taḥ kapīśvaraḥ |
vegena abhihato vālī nipapāta mahī tale
verses.translation: Hit by the fleetness of that arrow then that highly magnificent and intrepid lord of monkeys Vali fell onto the plane of earth.

verses.devanagari:
इन्द्र ध्वज इव उद्धूत पौर्ण मास्याम् महीतले |
अश्वयुक् समये मासि गत सत्त्वो विचेतनः |
बाष्प संरुद्ध कण्ठस्तु वाली च आर्त स्वरः शनैः
verses.iast:
indra dhvaja iva uddhūta paurṇa māsyām mahītale |
aśvayuk samaye māsi gata sattvo vicetanaḥ |
bāṣpa saṃruddha kaṇṭhastu vālī ca ārta svaraḥ śanaiḥ
verses.translation: Like the flag that will be raised in honour of Indra during the month of ashvin on a full-moon day, but thrown onto earth along with its flagstaff after the festival, Vali with depleted energy and dissipated vitality slowly fell onto ground, and with tears blocking throat he moaned piteously.
notes: Thisindra dhvaja ustava, festival of Indra's flagstaff will be undertaken after the sixth lunar month of year, usually after summer in order to appease Indra to cause rains. On full-moon day in Ashvayuja month [October-November] this will be performed and after the ritual the flag / flagstaff will be thrown to ground.

glosses.meaning: with painful, voicing - with piteous moan [ fell down.]

verses.devanagari:
नरोत्तमः काल युगांतकोपमम् शरोत्तमम् कांचन रूप्यभूषितम् |
ससर्ज दीप्तम् तम् अमित्र मर्दनम् स धूममग्निम् मुखतो यथा हरः
verses.iast:
narottamaḥ kāla yugāṃtakopamam śarottamam kāñcana rūpyabhūṣitam |
sasarja dīptam tam amitra mardanam sa dhūmamagnim mukhato yathā haraḥ
verses.translation: That best one among men Rama released a blazing and enemy subjugating arrow which in simile is like an Epoch-ender at the end of era, and that best arrow decorated in gold and silver looked like the glance from the Third-Eye of Rudra, emitting fire with smoke.

glosses.meaning: at the time of era end

verses.devanagari:
अथ उक्षितः शोणित तोय विस्रवैः
सुपुष्पित अशोक इव अचलोद्गतः |
विचेतनो वासव सूनुर् आहवे
प्रभ्रञ्शित इन्द्र ध्वजवत् क्षितिम् गतः
verses.iast:
atha ukṣitaḥ śoṇita toya visravaiḥ
supuṣpita aśoka iva acalodgataḥ |
vicetano vāsava sūnur āhave
prabhrañśita indra dhvajavat kṣitim gataḥ
verses.translation: That Indra's son Vali, dampened with blood and sweat, then looked like just felled Ashoka tree which has stemmed up and so far standing high on a mountain with fully bloomed clusters of its blood-red flowers, and when his anima is undone he even looked like the flagstaff on which a flag is raised in honour of Indra, but which is altogether dislodged and abandoned on the ground.
notes: Ashoka tree by itself stands high and stout with its blood red flowers, and by virtue of its growing on high of mountains it is more gloriously standing till now, like Vali, but that is felled too suddenly.

glosses.meaning: on mountain, stemmed up [standing high on mountain]
